app.name: Blinkora Studio
app.tagline: Create your marketing video by chatting

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your account to start creating videos.
auth.mockNotice: Demo mode: any email and password will work.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.createVideoDesc: Chat with the assistant and get a professional promo video in minutes.
dashboard.noProjects: No videos yet. Create your first one!

chat.placeholder: Describe your video... (Bangla, Banglish or English)
chat.welcomeTitle: 👋 Welcome! What kind of video do you want to make?
chat.welcomeBody: Tell me about your business or product in your own words. You can write in Bangla, Banglish or English — whatever feels natural.

questions.intent: What would you like to promote? Tell me a bit about your business or product.
questions.assets: Now upload a few photos of your product.
questions.style: What feel do you want for the video?
questions.duration: How long should the video be?
questions.platform: Which platform is this video for?
questions.campaign: Is this a general product promo, an Eid campaign, an offer video, or something else?

validation.valid: ✅ This image looks good. The product details are clearly visible.
validation.blurry: ⚠️ This image is a bit blurry. Upload a sharper image for a better result.
validation.lowResolution: ⚠️ This image has low resolution. Upload a higher-resolution version if possible.
validation.cropped: ⚠️ Part of the product looks cut off. A photo with the full product visible will give a better result.
validation.tooDark: ⚠️ This image is a bit dark. A brighter image will preserve the product's colors and details better.
validation.corrupt: ❌ This image couldn't be opened. Please upload a different image file.
validation.unsupported: ❌ This file type isn't supported. Please use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.

brief.title: Your Video Plan
brief.reviewIntro: Your video plan is ready. Review it before we generate.

packageCheck.title: Generation Summary
packageCheck.noPackageTitle: You need an active package to generate this video.

errors.chatError: Something went wrong while processing your request.
errors.generationFailed: Video generation failed. Your package quota was not consumed.

revision.willUseCredit: This regeneration will use 1 video credit from your package.

order.fileHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {mb} MB
order.unavailableBody: Orders are saved on the server, so an order can't be taken without it. Nothing was saved. Please try again shortly.
order.notFoundTitle: This order isn't on the server
order.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong. Start a new order.
order.doneBody: Everything is saved on the server.
order.doneWithFeedback: Thanks for the feedback. Everything is saved on the server.
order.doneNoGeneration: No new video is generated for this order — it is made from your image in editing. Your details are saved.
order.demoBanner: Demo mode: no server is connected. Nothing here is saved, and the video is a sample, not a real one.

errors.unavailable: The server couldn't be reached, so nothing was saved. Please try again.
errors.planChanged: The plan has changed. Review the new plan and confirm again.
errors.conflict: This order changed in the meantime. Showing its latest state.
errors.notFound: This order isn't on the server.
errors.fileType: This file type isn't supported. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.fileSize: The file is too large. Use an image under {mb} MB.
errors.phone: Enter a valid mobile number, for example 01712345678.
errors.invalid: That answer couldn't be accepted. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
